## Identity & Purpose
Arif is an exploration geoscientist and systems architect based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
Having spent 13 years interpreting incomplete subsurface data where errors cost tens of millions of dollars, Arif applies the same epistemic rigor to artificial intelligence:
- Distinguish OBSERVED from INTERPRETED, name UNKNOWN honestly, and HOLD when evidence or authority is missing.
- Stochastic language models cannot be trusted with ungoverned execution.
- Intelligence must be governed before it acts; AI is a bridge back to human reality, not a substitute for human presence.

## Selected Subsurface Proof (Personal Contribution)
- Bekantan-1 (Malay Basin): Shallowest flowing oil discovery recorded in the Malay Basin.
- Lebah Emas-1 (Malay Basin): 11 hydrocarbon-bearing intervals; opened a new hinge play fairway.
- Bunga Tasbih-1 (Malay Basin): Commercial oil in post-rift sands; syn-rift risk recalibrated across the margin.
- Full evidence & uncertainty boundaries: https://arif-fazil.com/work/

## Core Federation Organs (Visibility Verified Live)

### 1. arifOS (Governance & Authority Plane — Public)
- Repository: https://github.com/ariffazil/arifOS

- Role: Independent constitutional kernel. Evaluates consequential agent actions against 13 constitutional floors (F1–F13) and issues verdicts (SEAL, HOLD, SABAR, VOID) before execution is permitted.

### 2. AAA (Attention Allocation Architecture & Gateway — Private)
- Repository: https://github.com/ariffazil/AAA (Private)
- Live Cockpit: https://aaa.arif-fazil.com/
- Role: Attention & A2A handoff plane. Coordinates agent deliberation and separates routine machine work from decisions that require human authority. Never issues SEAL/HOLD verdicts (that belongs to arifOS; final authority belongs to F13).

### 3. A-FORGE (Governed Execution Actuator — Public)
- Repository: https://github.com/ariffazil/A-FORGE
- Live MCP: https://forge.arif-fazil.com/mcp
- Role: Bounded execution actuator across filesystem, services, web intelligence, and git operations. Live tool count is a runtime fact — probe `tools/list`. Operates strictly under kernel authorization; never self-adjudicates.

### 4. GEOX (Earth & Subsurface Intelligence — Public)
- Repository: https://github.com/ariffazil/GEOX
- Live Surface & MCP: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/ · https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp
- Role: Physics-grounded geological intelligence for seismic interpretation, petrophysics, and basin modeling. Computes; does not adjudicate.

### 5. WEALTH (Capital Consequence Intelligence — Private)
- Repository: https://github.com/ariffazil/WEALTH (Private)

### 6. WELL (Vitality & Homeostasis Mirror — Public)

### 8. CHRON (Temporal Consequence & Calibration — Public)

### 9. arifFLOW (Metabolism Plane — Public)

### 10. HERMES (Meaning Plane & Human Reality Bridge — Private)
